name: Itou Reia
source: A proprietor just as beautiful as Marie. She holds joint ownership of the gym known as the "Royal Family Fitness Club". She married Kisaku to gain control of the Sugimoto group, but ignores him otherwise, treating him as less than a dog. Her obsession with staying young and beautiful exceeds even Marie's.
